model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices, categorized by 4-Fbit and 8-Fbit representations. The x-axis is labeled "Block Index" and uses a discrete linear scale ranging from 0 to 31, with numeric tick labels placed at 0, 7, 15, 23, and 31. The y-axis is labeled "Sensitivity" and employs a logarithmic scale spanning from $10^{-6}$ to $10^{-4}$, with major tick labels at $10^{-6}$, $10^{-5}$, and $10^{-4}$ accompanied by minor ticks and horizontal dashed grid lines. Rather than lines, the data is depicted using vertical bars that form two distinct series corresponding to the legend. The "4-Fbit" series is represented by solid green bars that cover block indices 0 through 21; these values start at approximately $10^{-6}$ at index 0, experience a minor dip to their lowest point below $10^{-6}$ at index 8, and gradually trend upward to roughly $5 \times 10^{-6}$ by index 21. The "8-Fbit" series is represented by solid blue bars covering block indices 22 through 31; this series begins at approximately $6 \times 10^{-6}$ at index 22 and exhibits a steady, continuous upward trend, culminating in a peak value near $8 \times 10^{-5}$ at the final index of 31.
